caption:
seven days, seven decisions I didn't have to make

#routine #consistency #wellness

slides.text:
Mon — Lift heavy

Slept well, so it asked
for the hard one

Tue — Walk only

Yesterday was enough

Thu — Forty minutes,
lower body

Because I moved Wednesday

Fri — Eat more, sleep more

The week's numbers said so

Sun — Nothing at all

Written into the plan,
not stolen from it

slides.heading: A week that plans itself
slides.body: SOMA reads every night and every session, then decides what the next day should be — hard, easy or nothing
